newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.165 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.165 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Friday, Aug 15, was fixed at 20.1650 percent, or a fall of 26.00 basis points from 20.4250 percent, the rate for August 14, Banco de Mexico said on Thursday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Friday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
